idea-plugin.name: Bruno
idea-plugin.description:
Bruno Generator helps Spring Boot developers quickly create a Bruno collection from existing controllers.

The plugin scans Spring MVC endpoints, detects HTTP methods, routes, and request body parameters, and generates a ready-to-use Bruno collection with organized folders, request files, and example payloads.

It also creates collection-level variables to make it easier to point requests to local or remote environments, reducing repetitive manual work when documenting and testing REST APIs.

action.description: Generate Bruno files from Spring controllers
